text_blocks.snippet: The most common side effects of Jardiance (empagliflozin) include urinary tract infections (UTIs) and genital yeast infections.
snippet_highlighted_words: urinary tract infections (UTIs) and genital yeast infections

list.snippet: Increased urination: Going to the bathroom more often or larger volumes, as the medication removes extra sugar through your urine.
Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Burning when you pee, pelvic pain, or cloudy urine.
Genital yeast infections: Itching, redness, swelling, or unusual discharge in women or men.
Upper respiratory tract infections: Mild cold-like symptoms such as a stuffy nose or sneezing.
Increased thirst and mild dehydration: Feeling dry or lightheaded from fluid loss.

text_blocks.snippet: Get medical help right away if you experience signs of severe reactions:

list.snippet: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA): High levels of blood acid with nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, trouble breathing, or unusual tiredness—even if blood sugar is normal.
Severe Dehydration: Extreme dizziness, fainting, or sudden worsening of kidney function.
Fournier’s Gangrene: A rare, serious bacterial infection of the tissue between and around the anus and genitals, marked by severe pain, swelling, redness, and fever.
Low Blood Sugar (Hypoglycemia): Shaking, sweating, or confusion, especially if taken with insulin or other diabetes medications.
Lower Limb Amputations: New pain, sores, ulcers, or infections in the legs or feet.
Serious Allergic Reactions: Rash, hives, or swelling of the face, lips, and throat.
